> >> Burning Wrath (3 blood). Does this kill the
> >> ambush before damage is dealt, or does the ambush
> >> go out in a blaze of glory?
> >
> >The Brothers burn as soon as the strike is played,
> >before strike resolution.
>
> Does the fact that they burn before strike resolution, prevent the
> playing of rotschreck?

Rotschreck is an out-of-turn master card. Blood Brother Ambush is an action
modifier. Since !Brujah, the clan necessary to play Blood Brother Ambush,
cannot (currently) take actions out of turn, playing Rotschreck would be
impossible.

Best,

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No, but the fact that they are burned as soon as the strike
is played does. You cannot play Rötschreck until after the
strike is announced, at which time there is no combat
(since combat ends immediately when one of the combatants
is no longer ready.
